To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cytoplasmatic membrane is the precursor of the forespore envelope in spores of members of the genus B.

the forespore envelope of Bacillus species is a double layer of membrane derived from the cytoplasm and that membranous organaelles, connected to the cytoplamic membrane and to the forespore, are present during the early stages of sporogenesis.
the cytoplasm membrane plays a major role in spore formation and that the initial spore envelope is a double layer of the cytoplasm's membrane.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the participation of the cytoplasm membrane and its derivatives in the growth and spore formation of bacilli.
the role of cytoplasm in growth of bacteria.
the origin and nature and the possible function of the perisporal, cytoplasmic-membranous organelle in spore formation and in cell growth.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in Bacillus, the cytoplamic membrane participates in septum formation and spore envelope formation, and in the synthesis of the spore coat.
the forspore envelope is formed from the cytoplasmatic membrane.
the forspore envelope is a double layer of membrane derived from the cytoplasm and that the perisporal organelles are a continuation of the cytoplasm into the spore envelope.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cytoplasm of the vegetative cell is the precursor of the spore envelope and that the cytoplamic membrane is a major component of the spore wall.
the cytoplasm membrane is the major source of the spore wall, the spore cortex, the forespore envelope and the perisporal membrane.
the cytoplasm membrane plays a major role in the growth and sporulation of the genus Bacillius.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cell envelope is a dynamic structure that undergoes significant changes during the growth and sporulation of Bacillus species.
, in addition to its role in the formation of the forespore envelope, the cytoplamic membrane participates in the formation of transverse septal structures during growth.
the forespore envelope is a double layer of membrane, and that the perisporal organelles are connected to this envelope.
